segments.contextAfter: `src`: The source vImage buffer. Because the source pixel format is smaller than a byte, there are multiple pixels in each byte of the data buffer. This function interprets pixels as big-endian order. That is, the low-indexed pixel is in the high-order bits of the byte. For example, the eight 1-bit pixels `0b11100011` map to the eight 8-bit pixels `[255, 255, 255, 0, 0, 0, 255, 255]`. The conversion ignores any unused bits of the final byte of a row when a scanline ends in the middle of a byte.
